summary: Feed s124_double to SIEM is degraded due to tool overload: 2.24 Gbps microbursts exceed 1 Gbps SIEM port (224% capacity, 6 intervals) causing drops and event loss. One-way traffic (21.2% sessions) was detected but is tolerable for SIEM (needs_both_directions=false). No duplicates, VLAN gaps, drops, or encryption issues.

findings.root_cause: Aggregated traffic bursts to 2.24 Gbps exceed the SIEM's 1 Gbps ingress port. Packet broker forwards without load-balancing, filtering, or slicing, so egress buffers overflow during 1ms microbursts (6 intervals over threshold).
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM drops packets during bursts and misses events/logs, creating blind spots for correlation and detection. At 224% of port capacity, >50% of traffic in burst windows is lost before ingestion.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute bursts across multiple SIEM ingest ports (or upgrade to 10G) to keep per-port load <80% of capacity. SIEM needs_full_payload=false so slicing/filtering is also viable, but load-balancing preserves complete event fidelity without loss.
